title: EVPN Type-2 Route Missing — dc1-leaf1a VLAN 11 MACs not advertised
symptom: Host in VLAN 11 (VNI 10011) on dc1-leaf1a cannot reach hosts on dc1-leaf1b. MAC entries from dc1-leaf1a missing in EVPN table on remote leaves.
root_cause: redistribute learned removed from router bgp 65101 vlan 11 on dc1-leaf1a — local MACs not advertised as Type-2 routes
